english.meaning: to have mentioned something before; 提 plus the experience marker 過
english.note: 冇提過 means never mentioned. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Oh. But not mentioning it doesn’t mean it didn’t happen.
exampleSentences.traditional: 哦。但係冇提過唔代表冇發生哩件事吖。
